fundus: a retinal fundus photograph showing the optic disc, macula, and blood vessels, taken with a specialized fundus camera
a medical retina scan image of the inside of an eye
external_eye: a close-up photograph of an external human eye, showing the iris, pupil, sclera, and eyelids, taken with a regular camera
a photo of a human face focused closely on one eye
other: a photograph unrelated to human eyes, such as an animal, object, document, screenshot, or scenery

notes: Zero-shot CLIP gate (plans/archetechture.txt 'Van de B'), no training/calibration set -- verified with scripts/test_modality_gate.py on test_images/ (10/10 fundus), cataract_test/ (8/8 external_eye), and a handful of non-eye images (3/3 other). Argmax over the 3 categories, no separate confidence threshold: 'other' already acts as the reject bucket, so a low-confidence real fundus photo still needs to beat 'other' and 'external_eye' to pass, not clear some absolute score.
